svg.title: Selected MicroCol terrain and resource symbols, 2026-10-25
svg.desc: Editable tracing of user selection: terrains from 10, deposits from 09, other bonuses from 08. Row one: TerrainType.TERRAINS. Row two: nonempty ResourceOverlay values. 45px cells; resource motifs occupy the upper-right 27px. Row three: transparent terrain drawings. Flat terrain colours also tint the coast masks. Rows four to twenty-one: 120 ocean and 120 High Seas frames of the approved six-second wide wash (R-0293, 2026-10-26), with black 1.6px wave contours (R-0305, 2026-10-27). Lake frames append the approved K3 three expanding rings (R-0314, 2026-10-27); lake previews use frame 50.
